bifrost: springboard/src/media/ (audiofile.rs AudioDecoder, speaker.rs, aac.rs, mp4.rs, demux/mod.rs Sample), springboard/audiod/src/main.rs
summary: Core Audio Types is a set of C data types (buffers, channel layouts, timestamps, format descriptions, SMPTE time) shared by Core Audio. BifrOSt has no shared type set for these: the media stack passes plain rate and channel counts, interleaved S16 PCM and microseconds, and keeps its format and channel handling inside each decoder. SMPTE timecode and the OSStatus error model have no counterpart.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/speaker.rs (SpeakerOut::new(rate, channels)), springboard/src/media/audiofile.rs (interleaved S16 at the stream's own rate and channel count); springboard/audio/types/src/format.rs (StreamFormat, StreamFormat::validate); wired: springboard/apps/daw/src/rack.rs (describe), springboard/ui/src/audio_render.rs (StreamFormat)
features.note: The audio types crate describes a stream with rate, format, flags, packet and frame sizes, channels and bits per channel, and StreamFormat::validate rejects inconsistent descriptions (tested headless in audio/types/tests/parity_sdk-complete-30.rs). Gap: the speaker and file paths still build S16 streams from a rate and channel pair, and the descriptions are not verified on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/audiofile.rs (interleaved S16 packets); springboard/third_party/symphonia-codec-aac/src/aac/mod.rs (planar AudioBuffer<f32> inside the AAC decoder)
features.note: Buffers are a Vec or a planar decoder buffer. There is no multi-buffer list type shared with apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/aac.rs (downmix from 3.0, 4.0, 5.0, 5.1 and 7.1 bitstream order to stereo); wired: springboard/apps/daw/src/rack.rs (describe), springboard/ui/src/channel_layout.rs (ChannelLayout)
features.note: Channel order is handled only inside the AAC downmix. No layout tag or per-channel label is exposed, and the layout is not carried through the audio service. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/codec.rs (codec sniff from content type and first bytes)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Codec identity is an internal enum chosen by sniffing. There is no descriptor type that apps can query.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/demux/mod.rs (Sample with pts_us and dts_us in microseconds)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Only presentation and decode times in microseconds. No sample time, host time, rate scalar or flag set.
Timecode for broadcast and studio work. No sensible counterpart on a desktop without a timecode source.
Used for AudioUnit parameter ranges and conversion buffers. BifrOSt has no AudioUnit layer; volume is a plain level.

features.apple: AudioFormatID, Audio Format Identifiers (kAudioFormatAPAC and others)
features.bifrost: springboard/audio/types/src/codec_id.rs (CodecId::fourcc, CodecId::from_fourcc); springboard/src/media/mp4.rs (fourcc match on sample description entries, line 484); springboard/src/media/audiofile.rs (MP3, AAC, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, WAV decoders)
features.note: CodecId names linear PCM, AAC, MP3, FLAC and ALAC by four-character code and maps the codes back (tested headless in audio/types/tests/parity_sdk-complete-30.rs). Gap: the container readers still match fourcc locally, the decoders do not use CodecId, and APAC is not named or supported.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/mp4.rs (parse_asc, AudioSpecificConfig, object_type_name, asc_params, sbr_output_rate); springboard/src/media/sbr.rs (supported, Sbr::process; SBR for HE-AAC)
features.note: parse_asc reads the object type (with the 31 escape), the signalled sample rate (including the 24-bit form) and the channel count; object_type_name names AAC Main, LC, HE-AAC, HE-AAC v2 and USAC. sbr_output_rate reads the explicit SBR extension rate (including the 24-bit form), and a config that stops before the extension reports none (springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-30.rs). Gap: the decoder still outputs at the core rate and does not resample to the signalled rate. Tests: an_aac_lc_config_names_its_object_type_rate_and_channels, an_he_aac_config_reports_the_sbr_object_type_and_its_core_rate, an_escaped_object_type_is_32_plus_its_six_bit_value, sbr_passes_the_core_through_when_the_block_holds_no_sbr_data (springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10.rs). Not yet tested on Midget

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/demux/mp4.rs (Mp4Sample with offset and size per sample); springboard/src/media/demux/mod.rs (Sample with keyframe flag)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 28 tests. Each sample carries offset, size and keyframe. There is no variable-bit-rate packet table and no dependency description.

features.feature: Sample type and fixed-point canonical format
features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/aac.rs (decoder output converted to 48 kHz stereo S16); springboard/third_party/symphonia-codec-aac/src/aac/mod.rs (f32 internally)
features.note: The canonical format is an internal choice (S16 out, f32 in the decoder). BifrOSt does not use the 8.24 fixed-point AudioUnit format.

features.apple: kAudio_ParamError, kAudio_MemFullError, kAudio_FileNotFoundError, kAudio_UnimplementedError and others (OSStatus)
features.note: OSStatus is the C convention. The Rust Result and Error types cover the same cases in Rust.

features.apple: Not part of the framework (Core Audio HAL and AudioUnit)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/audio_format.rs (StreamFormat, pcm16, duration_ms); springboard/ui/src/pcm_convert.rs (sample formats and rate conversion); springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (the audio service owns the speaker and microphone); springboard/src/media/capture.rs (ALSA capture to S16 WAV)
features.note: Apps describe a stream with the stream format type and convert sample formats and rates with the PCM model, both tested inline. Gap: the SDK exposes no buffer or render callback, and apps reach the speaker and microphone only through the audio service.

gaps: No shared audio format description type (sample rate, channel count, bits per sample, format flags) for apps or services; formats are passed as two loose integers.
No channel layout model: channel labels and layout tags are not carried through the audio path.
No timestamp model beyond presentation and decode times in microseconds (no host time or sample time).
No buffer-list type shared between the decoders, the speaker and the capture path.
No public format or codec identifier enum; APAC is not supported.
SMPTE timecode is absent (n/a on a desktop with no timecode source).
